kbd.usage:
usage: victus-kbd <color|RGB> | cycle <color...> [--delay S] [--bg]
              victus-kbd stop | get | dump [offset] [length]
kbd.write_failed: write did not stick: wrote {wrote}, ec has {got}
kbd.ec_unavailable: EC interface not available (need ec_sys write_support=1)
kbd.cycle_need_color: cycle needs at least one color
kbd.cycle_running: cycle already running (pid {pid}) — stop it first: victus-kbd stop
changer.usage: usage: Changer <name> | R G B | #hex | list | random | off | cycle [colors] [--delay S] | cycle-red | stop
changer.unknown_color: unknown color '{name}' — see 'Changer list' (add: ColorMaker add {name} 255 105 180)
cm.usage: usage: ColorMaker list | palette | show <name> | add <name> <r> <g> <b> | rm <name>
cm.name_rule: name must be lowercase english: a-z, 0-9, '-', '_'
